svg.title: C / RED +5 V
svg.desc: Harness revision 13: ferrule branches at F1 LOAD, K5 power terminal 3 and K1 power terminal 3. One ferrule enters the clamp at each shared endpoint. Small AC terminals each receive one 14 AWG wire in a blue ferrule. Rail order W1, K1, W2, K5, K4, PS1, F1; sheet 07 is an enlarged GPIO connection view. Three box leads: black A01, white A08, red B04.
svg.text: 05 / Harness C / RED +5 V daisy chain
Two RED 18 AWG segments · PS1 +V → Slave VCC → Master VCC
5 V DC ONLY · C01 arrives and C03 continues from the SAME W2 VCC screw
SINGLE = one conductor · SHARED = listed conductors in ONE ferrule · FITTED = as built · DATA = remaining specification

g.aria-label: C01: Red, PS1 top LEFT +V, terminal 1 to W2 Slave / K3: top power RIGHT (+5 V) screw VCC
g.title: C01 · Red · PS1:+V → W2:VCC

g.aria-label: C03: Red, W2 Slave / K3: top power RIGHT (+5 V) screw VCC to W1 Master / K2: top power RIGHT (+5 V) screw VCC
g.title: C03 · Red · W2:VCC → W1:VCC

svg.text: C03: same W2 VCC → W1 VCC.
W2 VCC: C01 + C03 together in ONE 2 × 18 AWG twin.
PS1 +V and W1 VCC each have one single-ferruled wire.
DATA: record Waveshare single/twin wire ranges, strip and torque.
PS1 stays single on +V; confirm the actual ferrule/barrel.
Use the top VCC screw, not GPIO 3V3.
The requested shared end is visible at W2; no added connector is drawn.
WIRE BY ID · follow the end-preparation notes and assembly checkout · crossings do not connect
